Why these dates move crypto

FOMC decisions set the price of money. Cheaper money historically pushes investors toward risk assets like Bitcoin; expensive money pulls them out. The statement lands at 2:00 PM ET and the first minutes afterward are routinely the most volatile of the month — many traders flatten leveraged positions before it.

CPI is the inflation print the Fed reacts to. A single 0.1% surprise in either direction regularly moves BTC 2–5% in minutes, and liquidation cascades on leveraged positions amplify the move. If you trade with leverage, know when CPI drops — check it on our liquidations dashboard afterwards.

Options expiry concentrates billions of dollars of open interest into a single settlement moment. Into the quarterly expiries especially, spot price tends to gravitate toward the "max pain" strike, then trades freely again once contracts settle.
